description:
Add a new character state (for a taken textId — an error: update with `updateState`, remove with `removeState`).

        |A state in the character pipeline is a **permanent or long-term state** set at the moment of creation/update (an innate curse, a vow, a permanent buff/debuff, an active Wild Shape/Polymorph form if the character is created already in a form). For **temporary effects within a turn** (Concentration, Blinded for 1 round) — that is TurnCharactersBuilder.addState; here — what must be on the new character right away.

        |Use when:
        |- playerRequest says "he is cursed", "he has a vow of silence", "constantly hears a demon's whisper".
        |- A permanent state follows from a feature/race that other agents must see (for example, a druid-in-form at the start; a shifter with an active form; a lich NPC with textId='undying').
        |- Without `duration` — the state is permanent (until an explicit removeState). There are no hourly timers here — they are stamped by the turn pipeline when imposing temporary effects.
        |⛔ AN EMPTY `duration` = "THIS IS FOREVER". You may set it only if the state really is permanent (a curse, a vow, an innate trait, a maiming). Everything that has an end must carry it in `duration` as a VERIFIABLE CONDITION ("until a long rest", "fades when it attacks", "while wearing the amulet") — otherwise the state will hang on the character forever: there will be nobody to remove it, because the scene master will not know how it ends.
name: addState

value.description: Structured value (numeric counter/form name). null — no value.

duration.description: HOW THE STATE ENDS — a verifiable condition ('until a long rest', 'fades when it attacks', 'while wearing the amulet') or an explicit 'permanent, until removed by a ritual'. null = FOREVER, and that is allowed only for states that are permanent in substance.

source.description: textId of the source (feature/spell/'master'). null — not specified.

emoji.description: Emoji (recommended — without it the UI looks bare).

anyOf.description: all — public state, nobody — nobody knows except the carrier.
Non-empty list of character UUIDs who know the state (the holder always knows).

reason.description: Optional: closing reason/comment. Required for "decision items" of the checklist (for example, refusing a book promotion): such an item is closed by a SEPARATE call with an explicit reason, not silently in a common batch.

description: Mark several tasks as done in one call. Use for going through the working phase's checklist in a row (for example, closing several 'chk-*' items) when there are no intermediate decisions between them. If an idea appears along the way — close them one by one via completeTask. REVIEW items ('rev-*', the self-check phase) are NOT closed by this tool: each requires a separate completeTask with a verdict-specific in reason, batch closing is rejected.
